features.title: New context menus
features.description: Right-click a mail or a contact for a smoother, roomier menu. Move, Categories and contact lists open as submenus with their own search box, so you can type a few letters to find the right folder or category.

features.title: Calendar opens at the current time
features.description: Day and week views now scroll straight to the current time and show a line marking it, so you always see what's next. You can turn the line off in Settings > Calendar > Rendering.
